item.title: Last survivor of Hungarian underground seeks 'recognition of Jewish rescuers'
item.description: David Gur, who will turn 100 in March, forged thousands of documents that saved Jews in Nazi-occupied Hungary. He is among an estimated 3,000 Jews who risked their lives rescuing fellow Jews during World War II – yet Israel has never formally recognized their heroism. An action committee now seeks to amend the Yad Vashem Law to honor these forgotten heroes.
